attributes.board_name: New York State Education Department, Office of the Professions – State Board for Occupational Therapy

rules.accepted_credit_types: Continuing competency learning activities from NYSED-approved providers (e.g. AOTA, NYSOTA, IACET, NBCOT or equivalent). At least 24 hours on professional subjects (competent OT practice); up to 12 on related subjects (legal, ethical, regulatory, health care, reimbursement, supervision, business practices, professional conduct). At most two-thirds self-directed online study; at least one-third in person, live online or synchronous online, or other defined learning activities.
rules.new_licensee_rule: Generally exempt for the first 3-year registration period, unless previously licensed as an OT/OTA in another state.
rules.audit_note: Registration is reissued only if the licensee attests to 36 hours; a one-year conditional registration may be issued to a licensee who admits non-compliance. Mandatory continuing competency fee at registration ($45 OT, $25 OTA).
rules.legal_basis: Education Law Article 156 (§7908); Regulations of the Commissioner Part 76 (§76.10)
rules.notes: Professional license is valid for life; registration renews every 3 years. CEU conversion per NYSED: 1 hour = 0.1 CEU. Good-cause adjustments are possible. Licensees back from a lapse who practiced in another state must complete 36 hours.
rules.rule_quote: During each triennial registration period, meaning a registration period of three years' duration, an applicant for registration shall complete at least 36 continuing competency hours of acceptable learning activities, as defined in paragraph (2) of this subdivision…
